author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists discovered that fish exposed to benzoylecgonine, a cocaine metabolite, swim nearly twice as far as unexposed fish in Lake Vättern, Sweden. This field study provides the first evidence of drug residues directly altering wild aquatic animal behavior, raising new questions about ecological impacts of human drug pollution.

Source Article: https://www.cell.com/current-biology/fulltext/S0960-9822(26)00315-5
